anya: Quick heads-up: ran the long-context kv-cache fuzzbench on the new quant4 build (magnetXXq4). Hit a reproducible divergence at ~8200 tokens where outputs detach from float32 baseline.
lee: ugh. divergence how? hallucinations, token shift, or exact token mismatch?
anya: Mostly token-shift + conditioning bleed — the model starts repeating an earlier phrase and the cached KV indices look offset in the logs. Not a classic hallucination but coherence drops.
sami: Can you paste the small repro and the cache-hit metrics? Also which RoPE codepath (legacy vs scaled-rope) are we on?
anya: Using scaled-rope path by default (we switched that last week). Repro is tiny: run longprefill.py with a 10k prompt and compare last-100 tokens.
anya: ```python
# longprefill.py (trimmed)
from runner import Client
c = Client(model='magnetXXq4', seq_len=10240, quant='q4')
prefill = 'A ' + 'word ' * 10000
resp = c.generate(prefill, max_new_tokens=200)
print(resp[-200:])
```
anya: Cache-hit stats from the job (job 2026-ml-7823): cache_reads=1_234_567, cache_hits=1_233_942, hit_rate=99.95%, kv_miss_count=625. But the miss distribution clusters around token indexes 8190-8220.
lee: interesting — so miss rate tiny but correlated with a window boundary. Could be wrap/stride arithmetic when storing KV for quantized tensors.
sami: hypothesis: quantized KV storage pads differently causing a shift when RoPE index arithmetic does a floor/ceil mismatch. Especially with scaled-rope, the frequency mapping uses float ops that were quantized for keys/values. We saw similar off-by-one in int8 bring-up. Try forcing legacy-rope in the runtime to see if it changes.
anya: ran that: legacy-rope + q4 -> no divergence up to 10k, outputs match float baseline. scaled-rope + float32 -> also matches. scaled-rope + q4 -> divergence. So it looks like an interaction between scaled-rope path and q4 storage.
lee: great bisection. Can you capture a tiny KV dump (keys index around 8180-8225) and diff against float32 dump? even hex diffs of the quantized buckets would help.
anya: attached hex snippet in logs: "kv_idx=8184: key_hash=0x7f3a, bucket_offset=0x1f20" then next entry looks shifted by one slot.
anya: quick workaround: enabling kv-prefill-aligned-pad=1 in runtime config avoids the shift and fixes outputs for q4+scaled-rope. But it's a perf hit (~+6% latency).
sami: That points to an alignment/padding bug in the q4 serializer when scaled-rope is active. Could be how we pack rotary frequencies alongside the KV slab.
lee: action items: (1) open a bug with serializer team and link these reproducer steps + hex dump; (2) add a microbench to CI to run scaled-rope+q4 for 10k tokens (nightly); (3) keep the runtime flag as temporary mitigation for customers.
anya: filing bug now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-12987 — added logs, job id 2026-ml-7823, hex dump, and patch suggestion (align padding when using q4 packs).
ops-bot: ci/job/2026-ml-7823 finished: tests=14 failed=0 warnings=2 :white_check_mark:
lee: thanks. also double-check that the quant packing doesn't assume 64-bit alignment when runtime uses 32-bit strides on some GPUs — that might explain +6% when we pad.
sami: I'll try a small repro to see if changing the rotary scale constant (multiply by 1.000001) impacts the drift — if it does, the arithmetic ordering matters under quantization.
anya: noted. I'll keep the diagnostic flag on for the night run and follow up with a short note in the quay with benchmark numbers (latency/cost/regression). :thinking:
